📊 COMBINED DONATION BREAKDOWN

Okay, it took long enough, but here it is! 🫶🏻🥹

This report includes contributions from our first donation drive supporting three projects, as well as the Poon’s Birthday Gift Project:

First Donation Drive – Three Projects:
• MRS Filming Food Support – Provided meals for Ohm and Poon during My Romance Scammer filming.
• Poon’s Birthday Celebration – Allocated to gifts and preparations in coordination with Poon’s Official Fanclub.
• Ongoing OhmPoon Support Projects – Remaining funds were used for other support initiatives, ensuring balanced assistance for both Ohm and Poon.

Poon’s Birthday Gift Project:
• Goal: ₱4,000 | Total Collected: ₱4,300 ✅
Funds were used to prepare a heartfelt birthday gift for Poon, including a snack box and a snack bouquet for him and a snacks byouquet for his official fanclub, making his day extra special.

All donations were managed responsibly and allocated according to each project’s needs.

A heartfelt thank you to everyone who contributed — your generosity made these initiatives possible and meaningful! 🫶🏻🙏🏻✨
